feature.name: value_density_per_battery_budget
feature.code:
import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Value that survives the trip per unit of *battery budget* (not time): surviving value divided by the round-trip energy cost as a fraction of capacity, charger row = urgency of topping up relative to best visible density."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos[None, :], axis=1)
    t_go = d
    # value remaining on arrival
    val_after = np.clip(values - rates * t_go, 0.0, None)
    is_item = values > 0

    # energy to go and to get back to the charger
    d_back = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger[None, :], axis=1)
    energy = drain * (d + d_back)                       # round-trip energy in battery units
    # fraction of the *current* battery this round trip would consume; unreachable if > 1
    frac = energy / np.maximum(battery, 1e-6)
    reachable = (energy <= battery).astype(float)
    # energy density: surviving value per unit of battery spent
    dens = np.where(is_item, val_after / np.maximum(energy, 1e-6), 0.0) * reachable

    # normalise items among themselves
    scale = np.max(np.abs(dens)) + 1e-9
    dens_n = dens / scale

    # charger row: how many round-trips' worth of battery the best visible item costs,
    # gated by slack (only attractive when the battery is tight or items are cheap to reach)
    charger_row = ~is_item
    best_cost = float(np.max(np.where(is_item, frac, 0.0))) if np.any(is_item) else 0.0
    # charger urgency grows with battery depletion and with cheap reachable value
    charger_score = (1.0 - battery) * np.clip(1.0 - best_cost, 0.0, 1.0)
    out = np.where(charger_row, charger_score, dens_n)
    return out

name: value_density_per_battery_budget
feature.measures: Value that survives the trip per unit of *battery budget* (not time): surviving value divided by the round-trip energy cost as a fraction of capacity, charger row = urgency of topping up relative to best visible density.

feature.name: rival_snatch_fraction_and_lead
feature.code:
import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Value-weighted rival race: for each candidate, the fraction of its arrival value that a rival reaching the point first would still collect, discounted by the drone's own lateness vs. the fastest rival, clipped; 0 for charger."""
    pos = np.asarray(pos, dtype=float)
    targets = np.asarray(targets, dtype=float)
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    rates = np.asarray(rates, dtype=float)
    k = targets.shape[0]
    is_item = values > 0

    d = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos[None, :]) ** 2, axis=1))  # (k,)
    val_after = np.clip(values - rates * d, 0.0, None)

    # pairwise candidate-to-candidate distances
    diff = targets[:, None, :] - targets[None, :, :]
    dd = np.sqrt(np.sum(diff ** 2, axis=2))  # (k,k)

    # rival i arrives at candidate j at time d_i + dd[i,j]; drone arrives at d_j
    arrive_rival_at_j = d[:, None] + dd                # (k rivals, k cands)
    lead = d[None, :] - arrive_rival_at_j              # >0 means a rival is earlier than drone
    rival_is_item = (values[:, None] > 0)              # (k,1)
    rival_survives = val_after > 0                     # rival keeps value only if it's still an item
    earlier = np.clip(lead, 0.0, None)                 # how much earlier the rival is

    # value the earlier rival would snatch, decayed by the rival's own transit
    rival_val = np.clip(values[None, :] - rates[None, :] * arrive_rival_at_j, 0.0, None)  # (k,k)
    mask = (lead > 0) & rival_is_item & rival_survives[None, :]
    # discount rival's snatch by how much earlier it is (a rival arriving just in time steals ~ everything)
    snatch = np.where(mask, rival_val / (1.0 + earlier), 0.0)
    stolen = snatch.sum(axis=0)                        # (k,)

    # fraction of own arrival value that survives competition, i.e. we still get what the rivals miss
    own = np.maximum(val_after, 0.0)
    frac = own / (own + stolen + 1e-6)                 # in [0,1], 1 = unopposed
    # also reward being early: the margin by which we beat the fastest rival
    fastest_rival = np.where(mask, arrive_rival_at_j, np.inf).min(axis=0)
    margin = np.clip((fastest_rival - d) / np.maximum(d + 1e-3, 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0)
    margin = np.where(np.isfinite(fastest_rival), margin, 1.0)

    out = (2.0 * frac - 1.0) + 0.5 * margin
    out = np.clip(out, -1.0, 1.0)
    return np.where(is_item, out, 0.0)
feature.measures: Value-weighted rival race: for each candidate, the fraction of its arrival value that a rival reaching the point first would still collect, discounted by the drone's own lateness vs. the fastest rival, clipped; 0 for charger.

feature.name: endgame_one_way_density
feature.code:
import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Endgame one-way density: value surviving the flight per travel time, but only for items that expire before the drone could ever return to the charger; charger row gets the value-weighted exhaustion pressure of those stranded items."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    dc = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger, axis=1)
    is_item = values > 0
    tau = np.where(is_item, values / np.maximum(rates, 1e-9), np.inf)   # time until item dies
    val_after = np.clip(values - rates * d, 0.0, None)

    # "one-way" = cannot complete a round trip to the charger before the horizon,
    # OR the item itself dies before the drone could get back out to it.
    stranded = ((d + dc) > time_left) | (tau < d)
    # battery can never cover the outbound leg: also a forced one-way commitment
    stranded = stranded & (battery >= d * drain)

    # density: surviving value per unit of outbound flight time
    r = val_after / np.maximum(d + 0.05, 1e-9)
    score = np.where(is_item & stranded, r / (1.0 + r), 0.0)

    # charger row: pressure of all stranded items we would abandon by charging now,
    # scaled by how little horizon is left (endgame urgency)
    if not np.any(~is_item):
        return score
    strand_val = float(np.sum(np.where(is_item & stranded, val_after, 0.0)))
    urgency = 1.0 - np.clip(time_left / 20.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    charger_score = np.clip(strand_val * urgency, 0.0, None)
    charger_score = charger_score / (1.0 + charger_score)
    score = np.where(is_item, score, charger_score)
    return score
feature.measures: Endgame one-way density: value surviving the flight per travel time, but only for items that expire before the drone could ever return to the charger; charger row gets the value-weighted exhaustion pressure of those stranded items.

feature.name: age_decay_fraction_of_original
feature.code:
import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """For each item, the fraction of its starting value already lost (decay clock), signed so fresher items score higher; 0 for charger."""
    is_item = values > 0
    # estimate each item's value at appearance from history (match by nearest position)
    k = targets.shape[0]
    fresh = np.zeros(k)
    if history is not None and len(history) > 0:
        hist = np.asarray(history, dtype=float)
        # nearest recorded appearance for each candidate position
        dd = np.linalg.norm(targets[:, None, :] - hist[None, :, :2], axis=2)  # (k, s)
        j = np.argmin(dd, axis=1)
        v0 = hist[j, 3]
        r0 = hist[j, 4]
        # value we would have had at appearance; if unknown/zero fall back to current
        v0 = np.where(v0 > 1e-9, v0, values)
        # elapsed lifetime of this item since appearance
        age = np.clip(time - hist[j, 2], 0.0, None)
        # decayed value if never collected (for the item currently visible, value = v0 - r0*age)
        decayed = np.clip(v0 - r0 * age, 0.0, None)
        # fraction of original value already lost
        lost = 1.0 - decayed / np.maximum(v0, 1e-9)
        fresh = np.clip(lost, 0.0, 1.0)
    out = np.where(is_item, fresh, 0.0)
    return out
feature.measures: For each item, the fraction of its starting value already lost (decay clock), signed so fresher items score higher; 0 for charger.

feature.name: charge_net_gain_vs_best_density_price
feature.code:
import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Charger row: (unlockable value per charge time minus best current item density times charge time), normalised to [-1,1]; items 0."""
    pos = np.asarray(pos, dtype=float)
    targets = np.asarray(targets, dtype=float)
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    rates = np.asarray(rates, dtype=float)
    charger = np.asarray(charger, dtype=float)

    is_item = values > 0
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    d_back = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger, axis=1)

    # per-item density (items only; charger row has values 0 so surv=0 there)
    surv = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    t_cyc = d + np.maximum(0.0, (d + d_back) * drain - battery) / charge_rate
    density = surv / (t_cyc + 0.05)
    density = np.where(is_item, density, 0.0)
    best_density = float(np.max(density)) if density.size > 0 else 0.0

    # charge window
    t_ch = max(0.0, 1.0 - battery) / charge_rate
    d_c = d_back  # |targets - charger|
    alive = np.maximum(values - rates * (t_ch + d_c), 0.0)
    needs_charge = (d_c * drain) > battery
    unlock = float(np.sum(alive * needs_charge * (surv > 0) * is_item))

    gain = unlock / (t_ch + 0.1)
    opp = best_density * t_ch
    charger_val = float(np.clip((gain - opp) / (abs(gain) + abs(opp) + 1e-6), -1.0, 1.0))

    out = np.zeros_like(values)
    out[~is_item] = charger_val
    return out

idea.hypothesis: f086 fires the charger on raw unlockable value, ignoring what the drone could be earning meanwhile; in waves that produces 26% charger time. Pricing the charge window at the best *current* item density (not arrival rate, which f044/f061/f064/f096 already used and failed) should make the charger win only when the charge is worth more than the trip it displaces.
idea.feature: Charger row only; items 0. d=|targets-pos|, d_back=|targets-charger|, is_item=values>0. surv=max(values-rates*d,0), t_cyc=d+max(0,(d+d_back)*drain-battery)/charge_rate, density=surv/(t_cyc+0.05); best_density=max over items of density (0 if no items). t_ch=max(0,1-battery)/charge_rate. d_c=|targets-charger|. alive=max(values-rates*(t_ch+d_c),0). unlock=sum over items of alive*1{d_c*drain>battery}*1{surv>0}. gain=unlock/(t_ch+0.1); opp=best_density*t_ch. charger row=clip((gain-opp)/(abs(gain)+abs(opp)+1e-6),-1,1).
idea.lesson: f086 kept but flat on pickups; f096 (unlock minus visible melt) rejected, so replace the melt term with the opportunity price of the drone's time.

feature.name: value_flux_lull_charge_bonus
feature.code:
import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Charger row only: arrival-value-flux lull (recent vs overall) times battery shortfall; items 0."""
    k = targets.shape[0]
    out = np.zeros(k, dtype=float)
    if history.shape[0] == 0:
        return out
    W = 8.0
    recent = history[history[:, 2] >= time - W]
    flux_r = recent[:, 3].sum() / W if recent.shape[0] > 0 else 0.0
    flux_s = history[:, 3].sum() / max(time, 1.0)
    lull = (flux_s - flux_r) / (flux_s + flux_r + 1e-6)
    lull = float(np.clip(lull, -1.0, 1.0))
    charger_mask = values == 0
    out[charger_mask] = lull * max(0.0, 1.0 - battery)
    return out

feature.code:
import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Gated cycle density: only items keeping >50% of value on arrival, surv/(trip+recharge+0.05), max-normalised; charger 0."""
    pos = np.asarray(pos, dtype=float)
    targets = np.asarray(targets, dtype=float)
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    rates = np.asarray(rates, dtype=float)
    charger = np.asarray(charger, dtype=float)

    d = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - pos) ** 2, axis=1))
    d_back = np.sqrt(np.sum((targets - charger) ** 2, axis=1))

    surv = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)

    # recharge time forced by a round trip the battery cannot cover
    deficit = np.maximum((d + d_back) * drain - battery, 0.0)
    charge_time = deficit / max(charge_rate, 1e-9)

    t_cyc = d + charge_time

    is_item = values > 0
    gate = ((surv > 0.5 * values) & is_item).astype(float)

    raw = gate * surv / (t_cyc + 0.05)
    raw = np.where(is_item, raw, 0.0)

    m = np.max(raw) if raw.size > 0 else 0.0
    if m > 1e-9:
        out = raw / m
    else:
        out = np.zeros_like(raw)
    return out

idea.hypothesis: The champion already subtracts melt linearly, so items that keep only a sliver of their value still enter the competitor/opportunity comparisons and pull weight away from items it will actually deliver. A hard gate keeping only items that arrive with at least half their value tests whether those marginal items are a trap rather than a target.

import numpy as np

def feature(pos, targets, values, rates, battery, drain, charge_rate, charger, time, time_left, history):
    """Per candidate: rates*surv/(cycle time+0.05) with surv=max(values-rates*d,0), normalised by the max; 0 for charger."""
    d = np.linalg.norm(targets - pos, axis=1)
    d_back = np.linalg.norm(targets - charger, axis=1)
    surv = np.maximum(values - rates * d, 0.0)
    extra = np.maximum(0.0, (d + d_back) * drain - battery)
    t_cyc = d + extra / max(charge_rate, 1e-9)
    raw = rates * surv / (t_cyc + 0.05)
    m = np.max(raw)
    if m > 1e-9:
        return raw / m
    return np.zeros_like(raw)

nodes.description: Value density that accounts for the best follow-on pickup reachable after this one, so chains of items beat isolated high-value ones.

nodes.title: deadline vs horizon
nodes.description: Compare time-to-zero against time_left so items that will vanish anyway late in the game are not chased.

nodes.title: charge-adjusted density with rival melt
nodes.description: Value density per travel time where the denominator adds the recharge time the trip forces and the numerator subtracts the value of rivals that will melt during that forced charge.

nodes.title: horizon-scaled arrival rate
nodes.description: Local arrival rate from history, scaled by time_left so late-game opportunity cost of long trips rises sharply.

nodes.title: deadline slack vs remaining horizon
nodes.description: Score items by how much slack remains between time-to-zero and the trip plus the remaining game, so doomed late items are dropped.

notes.result: not attempted: no feature under it is close to a duplicate or to the kept features (nearest rho < 0.93, R^2 < 0.98)

nodes.title: charge during arrival lulls
nodes.description: Estimate the current item-arrival rate from history timestamps versus the session average, and give the charger a bonus when the recent rate is low, so charging and waiting happen in lulls instead of competing with visible items.

nodes.title: state-gated interaction columns
nodes.description: Return two columns: value density multiplied by battery state and by remaining horizon share, letting the linear policy weight the same density differently when the battery is low or the game is ending.

nodes.title: surviving-fraction competition density
nodes.description: Score items by surviving value fraction after travel divided by rival-adjusted density, mining the productive competition/survival group.

nodes.title: battery-gated density interaction
nodes.description: Two-column feature: value density times battery state and times horizon share, letting weights gate density by urgency.

notes.result: not proven: stays at lower priority

nodes.title: wide find: decay_fuse_fraction
nodes.description: Per-candidate: how much the candidate's own value decay ('burn') is slowed by arriving sooner, i.e. marginal value saved per unit time relative to the candidate's remaining lifetime — a pure decay-ur…

nodes.title: rival-melt cycle density
nodes.description: Value density per true cycle time where the numerator subtracts the value the strongest rival will take before arrival, normalised by horizon share.

nodes.title: expiry-window density
nodes.description: Density restricted to items whose remaining life exceeds the trip, so doomed items are dropped rather than chased.

nodes.title: wide find: rate_aware_urgency_gap
nodes.description: For each item, the value that would be lost by waiting one more unit of time (i.e. the decay the trip itself cannot avoid) minus the value the trip actually captures, normalised by the item's arrival…

nodes.title: temporal arrival forecast
nodes.description: Estimate expected value arriving per unit time at a candidate's neighbourhood from history timestamps (not just density), so spots about to receive items are preferred.

nodes.title: sparse-region short-trip bias
nodes.description: When local history density is low (scatter), strongly prefer short trips and the charger, since long flights to isolated items waste the horizon.

nodes.title: charging-window opportunity
nodes.description: Value the charger by the value that will appear during the charge duration, using recent arrival rate, so charging is timed to lulls.

nodes.title: wide find: horizon_cycle_occupancy
nodes.description: Fraction of the remaining horizon each candidate's flight-plus-return-and-recharge cycle occupies, squared and signed by whether the item expires first (arrival after death -> 0).

nodes.title: arrival field velocity
nodes.description: Estimate the drift of the item-arrival field from recent history centroids and credit candidates lying ahead of the moving front (waves).

nodes.title: multi-item tour value
nodes.description: Score a candidate by the value of the best short chain of nearby items collectible on one battery cycle, not just the single item.

nodes.title: endgame objective switch
nodes.description: When time_left is below one full charge cycle, switch to one-way surviving value with no return cost, so late items are not abandoned.

nodes.title: battery shadow price of travel
nodes.description: Score each item by surviving value minus a shadow cost of the battery its trip consumes, the shadow price being the recent value-arrival rate per unit battery; a net-value rather than ratio formulation.

nodes.title: burst-phase gating
nodes.description: Detect burst vs lull from recent inter-arrival rate versus the session average, boosting items near the recent arrival centroid in bursts and the charger in lulls; aimed at waves.

nodes.title: charger lull arbitrage
nodes.description: Give the charger a bonus when the recent arrival rate is below the session average, so charging happens in lulls and not in bursts.

nodes.title: expiry-gated density with rival melt
nodes.description: Density per cycle time but hard-zeroed for items that expire before arrival and discounted by the best rival that will beat the drone there.

nodes.title: endgame charger arbitrage
nodes.description: In the final charge-cycle window, decide charger vs item by comparing one-way surviving value against the value that will appear while charging.

nodes.title: wide find: age_decay_fraction_of_original
nodes.description: For each item, the fraction of its starting value already lost (decay clock), signed so fresher items score higher; 0 for charger.
